prompts.name: portrait
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate a premium original 3D mascot character portrait for the Memory Ray, a friendly manta-inspired creature for a personal-memory app. One character only, full creature visible, square studio composition with generous negative space, deep cool midnight-navy background and a soft floating shadow. It is a compact palm-sized fantasy manta ray with a broad rounded diamond silhouette, short elegant wing fins held in a gentle upcurve, smooth midnight-blue upper body, softly luminous pearl-white underside/front face and restrained thin turquoise rim-light along the wing edges. It has two beautifully expressive dark oval eyes on its FRONT-facing pearl face, a tiny confident sideways smile and two little curved cephalic fins like playful eyebrows. The creature faces the viewer in three-quarter view, gently tilting sideways with curiosity, floating in the air. A thin curved navy tail ends in TWO tiny white-blue lights with one delicate orbit arc between them, an iconic recognizable motif. It feels curious, calm and a little mischievous, intelligent and suitable for an adult iPhone app, charming and lovable with a clean strong silhouette. Tactile satin soft-touch material, subtly translucent fin edges, carefully controlled turquoise emissive accents, high-end polished 3D illustration with realistic soft lighting, excellent shape design and nuanced shadows. Cool navy, pearl and turquoise palette. No environment, no ocean realism, no text or logo or watermark, no paper, books, archive, clothes, arms or legs, no robot, no scary teeth, no oversized anime eyes, no generic spherical blob, no excessive neon, no visual clutter. This is an original branded creature design, not an existing franchise character.

prompts.name: floating-world
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Reference image 1 supplies the exact Memory Ray mascot identity. Create a NEW premium wide landscape isometric miniature world scene, not a character sheet. Preserve this mascot's rounded broad manta silhouette, midnight-blue upper body, pearl-white face and underside, expressive eyes, tiny smile, two curved front cephalic fins, thin turquoise wing edges, slender tail ending in two tiny orbiting lights. One mascot only. It is gliding playfully above a shallow dark reflecting pool suspended over a small floating basalt island. The entire freestanding miniature island is visible with generous breathing room, an elegant softly rounded rectangular charcoal stone platform with a layered sculpted stone underside, a slightly elevated thin pool basin with a restrained luminous turquoise rim. A few smoothly polished dark stones sit along the edge. A sparse constellation of tiny white-blue light points hovers just above the still water to symbolize memory fragments. The ray is guiding one small light forward with its wing; a single delicate curved light trail joins two other points. Focus on a carefully designed small world, intimate scale like a high-end smart-home app architectural maquette, beautiful reflected light and controlled soft shadows. Background is deep cool midnight navy, the island floats with no ocean or ground horizon. Premium sophisticated 3D render, subtle satin material, cool pearl and navy palette with restrained turquoise, quiet magical mood, uncluttered composition, slight overhead three-quarter camera angle. Keep the ray clearly visible and large enough to recognize its face while the entire island remains in frame. No buildings, shelves, books, paper, trees, flowers, people, extra animals, text, logos, watermark, interface controls, phones, glass dome, purple gradients or intense neon.

prompts.name: expressions
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Reference image 1 is the identity reference for the Memory Ray mascot. Create a premium six-pose expression and action sheet of this exact original manta-inspired creature. Wide landscape canvas, two rows of three full-body poses, consistent character size and material across all six, generous breathing room, seamless deep midnight-navy background, soft floating contact shadows, no grid borders. Preserve rounded diamond manta shape with curved wings, midnight-blue top, pearl-white face and belly, expressive eyes and small mouth, two curved front fins, restrained thin turquoise wing rims, slender tail with TWO tiny orbiting white-blue lights. Satin soft-touch subtly translucent fin material and elegant cool 3D studio lighting. Pose1: welcome, one wing raised in a small wave, bright relaxed smile. Pose2: listening, slight sideways tilt and attentive expression, wings gently curled. Pose3: curiosity/clarification, one little front fin cocked and asymmetric wing posture, thoughtful small neutral mouth. Pose4: recalling, swooping upward with one tiny white-blue memory light guided beside its wing, focused pleased expression. Pose5: connecting, wings spread around two small separated memory lights joined by one delicate curved trace, engaged expression. Pose6: small playful barrel roll, underside partly visible, joyful eyes, smiling, tail curling. Make distinct readable expressions suitable for an adult personal-memory app, neither infantile nor seductive. Both eyes consistently match the original creature's identity. Avoid human hands or feet, clothing, teeth, anime eyes, paper props, unnecessary particles, text, labels, captions, numbers, logos or watermark. Make all six whole characters visible and uncut.
